content:
Marta: Evening handoff — I'm covering 21:00-09:00 PT. Watchlist + quick tasks.

Marta: Watchlist (non-incident):
- KV-prefetch alerts: noisy ~10% of the time during bursts, seen as brief latency spikes on encoder pool. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/kvs/prefetch
- metric hysteresis on prefix_cache_hit_rate: rule flips when sample window < 30s, causing flapping alerts. See rule snippet below.

Raj: Confirmed. We're seeing false positives after autoscaler bursts. I tuned the rule locally to increase `for: 3m` — will propose change.

Sophia: Note: encoder pool `enc-pool-eu-2` reported 5% thread contention during load test at 20:02 last night; not impacting SLA yet but can amplify KV-prefetch noise.

Marta: Actionables:
- Raj: open a small PR to change alert for prefix_cache_hit_rate -> `for: 5m`, and add a recovery window. tag: `oncall-alert-tuning` :hourglass_flowing_sand:
- Alex: keep an eye on autoscaler bursts; if we see >3 evictions/hour, escalate.
- Jessie: validate prefetch stack traces for the higher-latency requests and paste any suspicious stacks here.

Alex: I'll watch autoscaler/SRM logs. If I see >3 evictions I'll post immediate update and put the system in manual scale for the short term.

Jessie: quick note — I pulled two traces, added them to the cloud storage: s3://redwood-debug/prefetch/traces/207654. Will run deeper tonight.

Raj: PR will be up soon. Proposed change:
```
alert: PrefixCacheHitRateLow
expr: rate(prefix_cache_miss_total[1m]) > 0.1
for: 5m
```
Comments welcome.

oncall-bot: Reminder: @Marta set rotation to 'night-shift' and notified @Raj as backup.

Sophia: FYI — no current runbook change required. If the trimmed hysteresis doesn't reduce noise, next step is sampling-window increase + smoothing on ingestion pipeline.

Marta: Code review pings: @Raj please add `changelog.md` entry and link to dashboards. @Jessie can you validate the traces tomorrow morning? I'll handoff to Raj at 09:00 PT and will be reachable via DMs until 09:30.

Raj: Will take over at 09:00. Thanks, team. :thumbsup:
